# MindX Global

> > AI-powered document data extraction platform achieving 97%+ accuracy across OCR, prescription processing, and multimodal computer vision projects.

MindX Global specializes in Document AI solutions for automated data extraction from PDFs, images, and messaging platforms like WhatsApp. Led by Mukesh Maran, the company delivers production-ready OCR and computer vision systems with proven accuracy across optical labs, healthcare, and enterprise document processing.

## Key Topics

- Document AI
- OCR (Optical Character Recognition)
- Computer Vision
- Multimodal AI
- Automated Order Processing
- Prescription Extraction
- WhatsApp Automation
- GPT-4 Vision
- Few-Shot Prompting
- Data Extraction
- EDI Integration
- PDF Processing
- Meta API Integration
- Healthcare AI
- 97%+ Accuracy
